meta.project: AI Business Assistant - Universal Voice Agent Booking System

product_overview: AI Business Assistant is an intelligent, AI-powered voice agent system that automates appointment booking, order taking, and customer service calls for diverse businesses. It utilizes OpenAI's Realtime API for natural voice conversations, seamless Google Calendar integration, and comprehensive analytics to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.
core_goals: Increase booking conversion rates via 24/7 availability.
Improve customer experience with instant, natural AI interactions.
Automate calendar management and confirmation notifications.
Provide actionable business insights through analytics and call logs.
key_features: Real-time AI Voice Agent powered by OpenAI GPT-4o Realtime API with WebRTC and voice activity detection for natural conversations.
Comprehensive Booking Management with calendar and list views, advanced filtering, status tracking, and integration with Google Calendar.
Complete Call History and Transcripts with full conversation logs, recordings, searchable transcripts, and export capabilities.
Robust Analytics Dashboard featuring revenue, booking, call performance, and customer insight metrics with various visualizations.
Extensive Business Settings for configuring business info, services, availability, AI assistant behavior, knowledge base management, and third-party integrations.
Secure User Authentication and Account Management using Supabase Auth with session management and profile settings.
user_flow_summary: Customer initiates voice booking via live demo or phone call; AI interacts naturally, gathers booking details, checks availability, confirms booking, and syncs with Google Calendar plus sends notifications.
Business owner logs in, views and manages bookings using calendar or list views, filters and exports booking data, and updates booking statuses.
Owner configures AI assistant and knowledge base by adding URLs, fetching and summarizing content to train AI contexts for improved responses.
Integration setup flow where business owner connects their Google Calendar via OAuth, enabling syncing of bookings and calendar events.
User authentication and account management including signup, login, password reset, profile updates, and secure session handling.
validation_criteria: All core features are fully functional and pass automated and manual tests.
Authentication system is secure and enforces Row Level Security ensuring data isolation.
Bookings can be created, updated, canceled, and synced correctly with Google Calendar.
AI voice interactions complete with natural latency (<2 seconds response time) and accurate transcription.
Call history records complete voice call transcripts linked to bookings with playback and export options.
Analytics display accurate metrics reflecting real user data and refresh in near real-time.
Business settings save and apply correctly including AI model configuration and knowledge base content.
User flows for booking, call handling, and calendar integration complete without errors or data loss.
System operates over HTTPS with environment variables properly configured in production.
UI is responsive and accessible across supported browsers with WebRTC and microphone access enabled.
